enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back. Close eyes. Inhale. Exhale. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Stretch legs. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Lie on stomach. Move arm. Turn head. Lie on back. Pull blanket. Inhale. Exhale. Remain still.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close closet. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Check mirror. Walk out of bedroom.

Put on coat. Zip up coat. Put on gloves. Put on hat. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at hospital. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check schedule. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check blood pressure. Check temperature. Administer medication. Change IV. Assist patient. Walk to next room. Sanitize hands. Open medical record. Review notes. Enter next patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer treatment. Walk to nurses station.
Go to break room. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch box. Close refrigerator. Open lunch box. Pick up fork. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Throw away trash. Wash hands. Return to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient list. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Change bandage. Assist with mobility. Walk to next room. Sanitize hands. Open medical record. Review notes. Enter next patient room. Greet patient. Check blood pressure. Administer treatment. Document care. Walk to nurses station. Consult with colleague. Update records.

Put on coat. Zip up coat. Put on gloves. Put on hat. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Add meat. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water.

Enter living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on couch. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Put feet on coffee table. Pick up remote. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Open browser. Check email. Open video. Watch video. Type comment. Use mouse. Scroll. Open social media. Browse. Close browser. Turn off computer. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on water. Adjust temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading or using phone to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Close book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll. Read article. Watch video. Put down phone. Turn off light. Close eyes. Pull blanket. Lie on side. Sleep.
